run_setup_install: run python setup.py install to install the habitat-lab package and its dependencies
run_setup_egg_info: run python setup.py egg_info to generate the habitat-lab package metadata
run_setup_sdist: run python setup.py sdist to create a source distribution of habitat-lab
get_package_version: call get_package_version to retrieve the current habitat-lab version string from habitat/version.py
get_long_description: call get_long_description to retrieve the markdown long description for the habitat-lab package
